description: Address semantic review findings: debounce token expiry warnings, add owner-only guard on !ig on/off, and add consecutive failure back-off.
steps: Fix token expiry warning spam: add lastExpiryWarningSent field to state, skip sending if less than 24 hours since last warning.
Add owner-only guard on !ig on/off in commandHandler.js: check fromJid against OWNER_NUMBER before allowing toggle.
Add consecutive error counter: track failures in state, notify owner after 3 consecutive failures, log warning after 10. Reset on success.
acceptance_criteria: checkTokenExpiry only sends a warning once per 24 hours (debounced via lastExpiryWarningSent in state)
!ig on and !ig off only work when fromJid matches OWNER_NUMBER
Consecutive API failures are tracked; owner is notified after 3 failures; counter resets on success
findings: All three review issues addressed. Syntax checks pass on all files. Added edge-case guard for empty OWNER_NUMBER in the owner check.
